body:
## Problem

Support tickets stay on "Processing" when the draft agent does not return a draft. The draft activity raises, the workflow fails before it records a result, and the ticket never leaves `in_progress`.

Three agent outcomes caused this:

- The agent ends the turn with no message (`EmptyAgentTurnError`).
- The agent ends the turn with a status sentence instead of JSON, such as "I'll wait for the background search".
- The agent server crashes, and the task run ends as failed with no message.

## Changes

- A ticket whose draft fails now finishes as a blocked draft after the retry, instead of staying on "Processing".
- A blocked draft has confidence 0 and verdict `blocked_on_knowledge`, so it never auto-sends and a person picks the ticket up.
- The first activity attempt still raises on any of these failures, so Temporal runs the configured second attempt.
- When the first turn has no draft JSON, the activity sends one follow-up that asks for the JSON object only.
- The parser takes the last JSON object that is a valid draft, so example or ticket JSON before the answer does not become the reply.
- The draft call goes through `MultiTurnSession.start_raw`, and all handling lives in `products/conversations`.

> [!NOTE]
> The draft task no longer sends `output_schema`. With a schema set, storing the output completes the task run before an agent message reaches the log, so the poll failed with "no agent message". The `0–1` confidence coercion from #105049 still guards bad scores, and the five one-shot model calls keep their JSON schemas.

The retry limit moves to the `DRAFT_ACTIVITY_MAX_ATTEMPTS` constant. Its value stays 2, so workflow replay does not change.

## How did you test this code?

- `TestDraftWithoutJson` covers each failure: an empty first turn, an agent crash, prose after the nudge, an empty nudge, and a crash during the nudge. Each case retries on attempt 1 and blocks on attempt 2.
- `TestDraftWithoutJson` also catches the parser taking example JSON before the final answer.
- Not run: a live draft against the sandbox agent.

## Automatic notifications

- [ ] Publish to changelog?

## Docs update

None.

## 🤖 Agent context

**Autonomy:** Human-driven (agent-assisted)

**Agent:** Cursor, Claude Opus 5.5

Skills invoked: `/writing-tests`, `/writing-pr-descriptions`.

An earlier version changed `products/tasks` to nudge and salvage inside the shared runner. That moved back into `products/conversations` so the PR does not change runner behavior for other callers.

Greptile review: the retry and final-JSON findings are fixed. The request to restore `output_schema` on the draft is declined, for the reason in the note above.
title: fix(conversations): finish support drafts that end without json
